messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in for pt-1001. Hope you're staying warm out there. Do you have a blood pressure reading to share, and how have you been feeling this week?
138 over 84 from this morning. Feeling alright I suppose. Mostly just lonely if I'm being honest. Nobody's made it out since the snow came. Two weeks now.

Logged that reading, thank you. Two weeks without a visitor in that kind of cold sounds genuinely hard. I can't arrange transportation or visits — that's outside what I'm able to do — but I'm glad you texted back. Did you take your blood pressure medication today?
Yes, took it with breakfast same as always. My daughter keeps saying she'll drive up from Fargo when the roads clear. I know she will. Just a lot of days between now and then.

Logged your medication for today. It sounds like you've got a good routine going even when the days feel long — that matters. Is there anything health-wise bothering you? Headaches, dizziness, chest tightness, anything like that?
No, nothing like that. I think I just wanted somebody to check in. Silly maybe.

Not silly at all. Your next check-in is set for seven days from now. If anything comes up before then — a reading that worries you, a new symptom, trouble with your medication — just text back and we'll go from there. Stay warm.

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
